summary: California BanCorp filed an 8-K reporting its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders and shareholder approval of the 2026 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan. The filing describes the voting results for director elections and plan approval, but does not involve a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special situation. The items include standard director elections, compensatory arrangement disclosure, and plan adoption. No price, premium, advisor, or structural terms are present. This is a routine corporate governance update with no event-driven or arbitrage angle.
